intent: fix overheating issues during intense gaming sessions
suggested_solution: Thermal Management: Utilize G-Helper to optimize thermals and fan speeds during gaming.
Fan Curve Adjustment: Use G-Helper to adjust the fan curve for a more linear sound profile, reducing the noise level.
PL1/PL2 Limits: Adjust PL1 and PL2 limits in G-Helper to maintain excellent FPS while reducing temperatures and fan spikes.
Profile Setup: Create a profile with maximum fan speed only during gaming to minimize noise.
Cooling Solutions: Consider using a flydigi BS2 Pro cooler or repasting the CPU to improve thermal performance.
